questions.evidence:
COMMUNITY STORY WALL: Share a memory of our neighborhood in one hundred to one hundred and fifty words. The memory should describe something you personally experienced. You may write in English or Chinese. Please avoid including another person's private contact details in your story.

Send your text by Friday evening. Volunteers may correct obvious spelling mistakes but will ask before changing the meaning. Selected stories will appear on the wall next month. Submission does not guarantee selection, and there is no entry fee or cash prize.

You may choose to show your first name or remain unnamed. Tell us your preference when submitting. Keep a copy of your original text because printed pages sent to the office will not be returned. Digital submissions are also welcome.

If a story mentions a living person in an identifiable way, check that they are comfortable with public display before submitting. For questions, visit the community desk on Tuesday afternoon. The volunteers can explain the process but cannot promise which stories will be chosen.
questions.explanation: 字數、親身經驗及公開署名選擇均符合。

A story requiring all printed pages to be returned.
